title: The Other Party
text: Another expedition is camped ahead, laughing around the fire, wearing the colours of a House that fell a hundred years ago. Their gear is old-fashioned yet new. They wave you over; they have not noticed the time.

options.label: The Leader tells them how long it has been, though it will break their hearts.

outcomes.text: They go very quiet. They give you everything they carry, then walk into the dark one by one.

options.label: Share their fire for the night, and let them keep their hundred years a little longer.

outcomes.text: They tell old stories of your Houses, some of them true, and laugh in the wrong places.

options.label: The quietest takes their supplies while they sleep; they will not need them.

outcomes.text: Old gold spends just as well. In the morning their camp is empty, the fire long cold.
